title: Ann runs the logistics and a Swedish tour
summary: Ann maps out his dates; he tours Sweden by a 35-minute crossing from Denmark, last playing with a band called Kris Bandits.

bands.name: Pa Pa Bue's Viking Jazz Band

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: Well, you can plainly see me living in Denmark and playing in all these countries how busy I really I was
So, uh, it was--- it was a job for my wife to keep this thing going and mapping it out, where I'm going to be and so on. How long it takes to get there--

Yes - she did all that and, of course, Sweden is just a little boat ride across the river-- I call it the river - it's not a river - it's the ocean - it's a place - it's 35 minutes from Denmark to Sweden. And, I go there and I toured Sweden many times with different groups, and colleges and all kinds of things and, uh, last time I was there, I was with a wonderful band called Buntahorn and His Kris Bandits--I don't know what that means, but Kris Bandit is the name of his band in Sweden -- I don't know what that means, but it's a good band and, uh, then Germany. I've been to Germany twenty times with the Pa Pa Bue Band
